Implement backend/src/main/java/com/kaapstyle/account/controller/AccountLifecycleController.java only.
- @RestController @RequestMapping('/api/account') @CrossOrigin
- Autowire AccountLifecycleService via constructor injection.
- Endpoints:
  * @PostMapping('/{userId}/delete'): accepts Map with 'password', calls accountLifecycleService.requestAccountDeletion(userId, password), returns 200 OK with deletionScheduledAt.
  * @PostMapping('/{userId}/cancel-deletion'): calls accountLifecycleService.cancelAccountDeletion(userId), returns 200 OK with message 'Deletion cancelled.'
  * @PostMapping('/{userId}/gdpr-export'): calls accountLifecycleService.requestGdprExport(userId), returns 200 OK with GdprExportRequest.
  * @GetMapping('/{userId}/gdpr-export/status'): calls accountLifecycleService.getExportStatus(userId), returns 200 OK with latest GdprExportRequest.
- Include clean ExceptionHandler for IllegalArgumentException and ResponseStatusException.
